package.name: varietas_kinematics
package.description: The robot description the algebra consumes: chains of revolute, prismatic and fixed joints with exact rigid placements, independent of any file format. The tangent half-angle rationalisation, the workspace implicitization and the singular locus are built on this structure, and a URDF front end is later a translation into it rather than a dependency of the pipeline. Header-only; needs nothing but varietas_core.
